panels.description: Percentage of request time estimated from existing aggregated span-duration metrics. Shared project dependencies can include background calls; concurrent spans are normalized rather than attributed from trace trees. This is not an exact Datadog execution-time calculation. Only dependencies with recorded duration in the selected time range are listed; zero-valued entries are hidden in the tooltip. Dependency entries are grouped by recorded normalized service and database instance. S3 bucket names and HTTP/Redis endpoint identities are not available in the existing metrics.
